Transverse oscillator [A2LEVEL-6] operates under the relation the linear operator matrix \( A = \begin{pmatrix} 8 & 9 \\ 0 & 7 \end{pmatrix} \). What is the sum of the eigenvalues (the trace \( \text{tr}(A) \))?
pool.sol: The sum of the eigenvalues of any square matrix equals its trace (the sum of the main diagonal entries): \( \text{tr}(A) = 8 + 7 = 15 \).

pool.text: Show \( x^3+x-5=0 \) has a root in \([1,2]\). Use Newton-Raphson with \( x_0=1.5 \) to find the root to 3 d.p.

pool.text: Solve \( |2x-8|=9 \) for \( x \). What is the larger of the two solutions?
pool.sol: \( 2x-8=\pm 9 \), giving \( x=\dfrac{17}{2} \) or \( x=-\dfrac{1}{2} \). The larger solution is \( x=\dfrac{17}{2} \).

An interval of width 32 containing a root must be reduced to width at most 1 using repeated bisection. Find the minimum number of bisections required.
pool.sol: Halving repeatedly, after \( n \) bisections the width is \( 32/2^n \). The smallest \( n \) with \( 32/2^n\le 1 \) is \( n=5 \) (width becomes \( 1 \)).
